references.fact: libvips-dev and libvips-tools are supplied during builds and at runtime
Plain pyvips needs libvips separately; CFFI ABI mode needs the shared library and does not require development headers. The optional binary extra has a reduced feature set.
Runtime package supplies libvips and linked dependency closure; install control is a diagnostic, not an immutable platform supplier.

cause: one native image generator chooses pinned language bases and adds JS/FFmpeg/runtime defaults, but no libvips shared-library supplier; selected Python base lacks libvips. Actual native hosted result pending; no other-base failure claim.
